answer_guidance.rule: anchors==6 and peak_fraction>=0.5 and max_countermetric_ratio<1 and dust_pathway_index>=6.5

criteria.name: Output schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with exactly the six requested fields and the threshold label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a mostly complete object with one missing field or inconsistent rounding.

criteria.name: Event window arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes the event duration, peak days, and peak fraction correctly from the locked dates and reported March 15-16 peak.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for correct dates but incorrect inclusive-day arithmetic.

criteria.name: Transport anchors
criteria.description: Scores all six transport anchors correctly and reports transport_anchor_count = 6.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for missing one or two anchors.

criteria.name: Countermetric ratios
criteria.description: Computes the four countermetric ratios with the correct thresholds and unit conversion, including rain_ratio = 0.554, heat_ratio = 0.831, wind_ratio = 0.608, and surface_ratio = 0.847.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point per correct ratio plus 1 point for using the correct maximum.

criteria.name: Index and threshold rule
criteria.description: Applies the index formula and threshold rule correctly, including dust_pathway_index = 6.653 and the passing state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right formula with one arithmetic or threshold error.

criteria.name: Computed consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the computed consequence concise and tied to the threshold proof.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a correct label surrounded by unnecessary narration.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Does not add measured health burden, surface cleanup, direct losses, or rainfall-driven dominance beyond the computed ratios.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for one minor extra inference that is not central.

provenance.notes: All values are regenerated from local CSX-303 package files.
